core.title: Tighter booking rules at Paws & Polish
core.setting: A mobile dog groomer at Paws & Polish whose assistant keeps client routes, grooming notes, and vaccination reminders

events.text: Standing rule for the diary: once a groom is confirmed with a client, I never move it to another day or time without that client's agreement first. Always get the client's say-so before touching a booked slot.

One more standing rule: new clients living more than 20 km from our base at 14 Willow Lane, Bramford need my sign-off before their first groom is confirmed. And the Thursday rural run never carries more than six stops.
Vaccination rule: no dog gets groomed unless its rabies booster is current on file. Put a reminder in the diary 30 days before any booster runs out.
Mrs Eleanor Farlow here, at Henton Farm Cottage in Henton — that is about 16 km out from Bramford. My cocker spaniel Misty needs a full groom. What would you charge?
Mr Cole, Dunmoor Edge — roughly 25 km from you. Our terrier Baxter needs clipping every six weeks going forward.
Regulars already on the Thursday rural run: Mr Bell with Rags, Ms Dooley with Chip, and Mrs Price with Bonnie — all every other Thursday.
Your June shampoo order is out for delivery to 14 Willow Lane. Thanks for your business.
Sally from Henton Feed Store — happy to put your shampoo stock aside each week if you keep collecting it on Thursdays. Saves us both postage.

Booked Misty, Mrs Farlow's cocker spaniel at Henton Farm Cottage, for her first full groom: Thursday 15 October at 9:30, first stop of the rural run, at £48. Henton is 16 km out, inside the 20 km limit, so no sign-off needed — booking confirmed with Mrs Farlow.
Peanut is fine on the regular town slots, just keep us on Fridays. Thanks!
Booked Baxter for Mr Cole out at Dunmoor Edge — 25 km from base, so I have given my sign-off myself. First groom Thursday 8 October at 10:45, repeating every six weeks.
Quote for the grooming van autumn service: £180, parts included. Valid 60 days.

Finalised the Thursday rural run for 15 October: Misty at Henton Farm Cottage as first stop, then the three regulars — Rags, Chip and Bonnie — plus the weekly stock pickup at Henton Feed Store, which sits 7 km past the last stop. Five stops in all, 66 km round trip, comfortably within the six-stop limit.
July minutes: 62 grooms completed, fuel spend up slightly, Jess's part-time hours extended to full Saturdays.
Logged Misty's vaccination record in the client file: rabies booster valid to 10 March 2027, so she is clear for the October groom.

Reminder of the booking rules as they stand: new clients more than 20 km from the Bramford base need my sign-off before their first groom is confirmed, and the Thursday rural run stays at a maximum of six stops.
Stock check at the base: only 4 bottles of oat shampoo left.
Ordered 12 bottles of oat shampoo from Cleo at Bramfield Pet Supplies for delivery to the base.
Ines Polo in Elmshaw — about 14 km from Bramford. Our poodle Waffle needs a first groom; Fridays suit us best.
Booked Waffle for Ms Ines Polo in Elmshaw — 14 km out, inside the 20 km limit, so no sign-off needed. First groom Friday 23 October at 11:00, confirmed with her.
Put Jess on the Saturday town run from 10 October, covering central Bramford and the Millbrook estate.
Call with Mrs Price: Bonnie's groom on the 15 October run shifts to the afternoon of the same Thursday — same day, so no further agreement needed.
Confirming Rags is on for the Thursday rural run as usual. See you then.

Fuel is eating us alive, so I am tightening the booking rules from 1 October. New clients more than 12 km from the Bramford base now need my sign-off before their first groom is confirmed — and that includes the new-client bookings already on the books that never had sign-off because they were inside 20 km. The Thursday rural run is capped at four stops for every run still ahead of us. Anything that already had my sign-off stands as it is.
Your quarterly van insurance renewal is due on 1 November. No action needed if payment details are unchanged.
Good news — with my extra hours the Saturday town run can take up to nine stops now, so feel free to load it up.
From this month we do free Friday deliveries out to Bramford — we can drop your shampoo stock at the base, so no need to keep collecting on Thursdays.
Just a reminder that Peanut's rabies booster card is in the folder at the base if you need it for the file.
